title: Not cotton, otherwise it's great.
text: Not cotton, otherwise it's great.. This product is the right size and has some good features however I thought it was cotton terricloth... it is not. It is microfiber terricloth and that's why I gave it three stars -personal preference. I thought I read the description carefully, maybe I did not? The feel of the fabric is not to my liking. This may work for you if that type of fabric does not bother you.

product_metadata.title: Kovot Beach Chair Towel Cover – Super Absorbent and Soft – Lounge Chair Towel Cover with Pockets – 84 x 26 Inches Light Blue Quick Drying Tanning Towel Cover – Turns into a Tote Carry Bag – 2 Pack
features: PREMIUM QUALITY: Made using high-quality cotton terry and polyester, the pool lounger cover is a reliable choice. The machine-washable beach towel is not going to lose its quality no matter how many times you wash or use it.

CONVENIENT DESIGN: When not in use, the beach lounger cover can be folded and converted into a carry tote, to keep your belongings. Carry your phone, magazines, sunscreen, sunglasses, and even your laptop in this large tote bag.

SOFT MATERIAL: With its perfectly soft and super absorbent material, the quick dry towel makes a preferred choice for everyone. The sun lounger cover towel keeps your chair cool and makes you comfortable without sticking to your skin.

ERGONOMIC CHOICE: This tanning chair cover perfectly fits any beach chair. Our cover towel comes with a hanging side pocket with 3 compartments, to keep beach accessories and other belongings within an easy range.

VARIOUS USES: Use the lounge chair cover to have all the water fun with your friends and family at the beach, pool, or just lounging around. Our 2-in-1 beach chair covers turned into a carry tote when not in use.
EACH TOWEL MEASURES: 84"L x 26"W - Machine Washable, this towel makes an ideal gift for water lovers on any special occasion.
description: Looking for a soft and comfortable towel cover for your pool chair? Need something reliable and durable?
Our Lounge Chair Towel Cover is just the right choice.
